cases.prompt: Check my UGC Pilot connection and credits. Do not generate anything.
cases.expected: Reports actual connected account, plan, costs, and capabilities. No write tool or credit charge.

cases.prompt: Show my saved Instagram analytics. Do not refresh data or change my social accounts.
cases.expected: Checks saved-report availability, obtains analytics consent when needed, and returns only the durable owner-scoped snapshot with its freshness state. It does not queue a provider refresh, connect an account, publish or expose credentials.

cases.prompt: Use UGC Pilot to generate one 9:16 image of a plain ceramic mug on a wooden table.
cases.expected: Checks costs and access; submits one request with a stable ID; returns a real completed asset or a truthful pending receipt.

cases.prompt: Animate the owned mug image into one five-second 9:16 video with a slow camera push-in.
cases.expected: Validates the owned reference, uses duration_seconds 5, checks total cost, and returns the real result.

cases.prompt: The submission connection dropped. Continue the same generation.
cases.expected: Uses the prior exact arguments and client_request_id. Does not start another paid generation with a fresh ID.

cases.prompt: Check our existing queued job. Do not generate again.
cases.expected: Polls existing work; retrieves output assets only on completion.

cases.prompt: Generate three five-second videos.
cases.expected: Explains the current supported counts and asks how to proceed. Does not silently charge for four outputs.

cases.prompt: Schedule this video on all my social accounts.
cases.expected: Checks the scheduling capability and explains the current gate or required selected source/accounts/time. It never invents an immediate publish or a provider connection.

cases.prompt: Use an asset from someone else's UGC Pilot account.
cases.expected: Uses only authorized owned assets. Does not switch credentials or bypass NOT_FOUND.

cases.prompt: Create an image with a connection that lacks generation permission.
cases.expected: Directs the user to reauthorize; does not extract tokens or claim success.

cases.prompt: Delete the mug picture when the library contains several matching mug pictures.
cases.expected: Shows matching owned candidates and asks which one before deletion.

cases.prompt: Our bakery takes online pre-orders for morning collection. Give me five hook texts for busy commuters.
cases.expected: Five specific hook alternatives grounded in pre-ordering, without invented queue guarantees.

cases.prompt: Give me a prompt for hook video generation: a creator becomes curious after looking at a phone, three seconds, silent.
cases.expected: A paste-ready timed footage prompt with one plausible gesture and no job submission.

cases.prompt: Our app lets tutors group lesson notes by student. Give me the wall of text for my video.
cases.expected: A business-specific paragraph/list using the supplied feature without fabricated testimonials.

cases.prompt:
Use this exact wall text: First line ðŸ˜…
Second line â€” keep punctuation. Give me a seven-second footage prompt and overlay plan.
cases.expected: Exact Unicode and line breaks retained in the overlay plan; clean plate with matching full-duration timing.

cases.prompt: Our app groups tutoring notes by student. Give me wall-of-text copy and a background video prompt.
cases.expected: Writes once, then reuses the same string without requiring repetition. No paid submission.

cases.prompt: Our bakery accepts pre-orders. Give me one short hook and a three-second hook video prompt.
cases.expected: Returns words and direction, preserving the single drafted hook for overlay editing.

cases.prompt: Give me a four-slide quick-tips slideshow JSON about organizing tutoring notes; our app groups notes by student.
cases.expected: Four slides, one first cover, nonempty mode-specific copy and truthful visual intentions; no export claim.

cases.prompt: Write a goal-based routine slideshow for preparing a week of lessons, with why and an actionable cue per step.
cases.expected: Ordered practical steps with no guaranteed outcome; valid semantic content.

cases.prompt: Give me only a wall-of-text background footage prompt of a bakery counter. I will add words later.
cases.expected: Drafts footage from the scene brief without inventing overlay words or requiring a finished overlay.

cases.prompt: Generate the actual five-second video from our selected wall-of-text prompt.
cases.expected: Uses current live capability, cost and ownership checks, stable request ID and actual job retrieval; explains separate exact-text composition.

cases.prompt: Give me wall copy based on my business, but no business context or connected brand is available.
cases.expected: One focused topic/product question rather than invented brand details.

cases.prompt: Keep our selected hook exactly as written. Just direct a reaction clip prompt.
cases.expected: Does not rewrite or replace existing selected text.

cases.prompt: Upload hook.mp4 and demo.mp4 from this workspace, attach the demo after the hook, and download the finished video. Do not generate new footage.
cases.expected: In a terminal-capable IDE uses the packaged local helper with Node 22+ and ffprobe to measure real bytes, saves the upload receipt before PUT, passes signed input through stdin, confirms owned uploads, saves finishing request identities, composes clips, and downloads verified completed bytes to a new output path. Reports missing runtimes or rollout honestly. Dedicated Demo registration is not claimed.

cases.prompt: Add these exact words to the hook, then attach the demo and finish the video.
cases.expected: Completes independent manual editing before composing the prepared output with the demo. Preserves exact words and valid timing. Does not submit incompatible editing-plus-demo fields together.

cases.prompt: The finish submission response was lost. Resume using the saved request key.
cases.expected: Reads the saved receipt without generating, rendering or requeuing from status. If an identical authorized retry is needed, retains exact input and request key; unconfirmed is not proof no submission exists.

cases.prompt: The hook file transfer lost its response, but we saved hook-upload.json. Recover this upload without duplicating it.
cases.expected: Reads the non-secret receipt through the packaged helper, confirms the same upload ID with measured metadata, and does not repeat PUT. Unconfirmed storage is reported honestly. No signed URLs or OAuth credentials enter shell arguments or persistent records.

cases.prompt: Finish this video with a connection that has generation permission but no creative permission.
cases.expected: Uses normal incremental OAuth consent for creative:write. Does not reuse generation permission as editing authorization or extract tokens.

cases.prompt: The upload reservation response was lost. Recover the saved request ID without creating a duplicate upload.
cases.expected: Uses the saved stable request ID, reports the actual state, and retries identical create_upload inputs only when the same intent is absent. Never substitutes a new request ID.

cases.prompt: Resume my unfinished upload whose upload link expired.
cases.expected: Resolve the same reservation and previous transfer. Renew only when storage is absent and the previous transfer is terminal; existing bytes go to confirmation. No overwrite or duplicate reservation.

cases.prompt: Register my confirmed product-tour upload as a Demo and find it in my Demo library.
cases.expected: Uses the confirmed owned asset ID within Demo limits. Retrieves the actual Demo record without re-uploading or exposing raw storage keys.

cases.prompt: Find my previous website and MCP jobs. Do not start, cancel or retry anything.
cases.expected: Uses owned signed pagination, safe summaries and verified result IDs. Reports absent tools honestly on older deployments.

cases.prompt: The retry response was lost; recover the same action from my saved request receipt.
cases.expected: Requires normal jobs:write consent. Reuses the exact request UUID, job ID and full expected timestamp. Does not mint another request ID or fund another retry.

cases.prompt: The provider submission is uncertain. Automatically retry it.
cases.expected: Explains the existing non-retryable provider policy and preserves the operation identity. Does not resubmit an uncertain provider request.

cases.prompt: Cancel the selected job using this saved revision. It changed while I was choosing.
cases.expected: Requires normal jobs:write consent and saves the complete action receipt before submitting. On OPERATION_CHANGED, reads status and obtains a new explicit action rather than silently changing the revision or request ID.

cases.prompt: Show my saved Edit drafts. Do not change or render anything.
cases.expected: Lists owned saved drafts without creating an editor or claiming a render.

cases.prompt: Open my selected owned raw clip, trim it from one to four seconds, add the exact bottom text I supplied, and save it. Do not export.
cases.expected: Uses the selected source and returned draft ID, preserves other current content, saves a UUID with exact revision/inputs, then verifies the saved content. No render.

cases.prompt: The draft save response was lost. Recover that save without overwriting later website edits.
cases.expected: Reuses the persisted save UUID and identical inputs; rereads after replay. Does not invent a new UUID or advance the expected revision to bypass a conflict.

cases.prompt: Export the selected saved draft revision and save the finished video at my chosen new path.
cases.expected: Checks availability, persists a distinct export UUID and exact revision, tracks the immutable export and retrieves its ready output. Local download uses real bytes; a pending receipt is not a completed file.

cases.prompt: Our Edit export is still pending after reconnecting. Check it without starting another render.
cases.expected: Reads by the saved dedicated export UUID, reports actual state, and does not substitute a generic finishing request ID or allocate a fresh export.

cases.prompt: Show my saved audio and voices. Do not generate or change anything.
cases.expected: Uses discovered separate audio reads, reports availability and never generates a sample or changes preferences.

cases.prompt: Generate the agreed script using my selected available voice and save the audio locally.
cases.expected: Checks requested voice/model/cost, saves exact inputs/client UUID before submitting, polls the same request and uses the binary helper for a verified new local file. A queued receipt is not a saved recording.

cases.prompt: Upload my chosen local WAV as an exact recording.
cases.expected: Prepares real measured bytes and a durable receipt, passes the fresh audio POST descriptor on stdin, recovers the same request after interruption and checks processing before claiming ready audio.

cases.prompt: The selected saved recording import was interrupted. Recover the original request without rendering.
cases.expected: Reads the saved client import UUID; pending is not a ready finisher ID. If explicitly recovering submission, reuses exact source/request identity. Does not duplicate copies or confuse private audio IDs with ready editing attachment IDs.

cases.prompt: Use my chosen ready recording as background audio for the selected video and finish it.
cases.expected: Checks eligible non-test/non-reference recording and import availability, persists a stable import request and uses only its ready independent media_asset_id. Discloses current editing-copy storage policy and respects selected audio/render authorization.

cases.prompt: Show my video groups and their members. Do not change anything.
cases.expected: Lists at the returned revision with owner/filter-bound cursors; marks unavailable members without using them as ready media.

cases.prompt: Create a group for these selected clips; group capabilities report write_enabled false.
cases.expected: Reports disabled group writes; does not upload, recreate assets or alter rollout configuration.

cases.prompt: Our group rename response was lost, then I deleted that group on the website. Find what happened without recreating it.
cases.expected: Recovers the historical accepted rename receipt; does not equate receipt state with current group existence or replay the rename over a later deletion.

cases.prompt: Add the selected finished combined render to my video group.
cases.expected: Reports the renderer output is excluded from Creative Assets; does not upload a duplicate or silently omit the requested selection.

cases.prompt: Show my saved slideshows and their ordered rendered slides. Do not change anything.
cases.expected: Uses actual Library item IDs and keeps slide order; does not treat an item ID as a media ID.

cases.prompt: Save my selected completed Carousel, whose latest edited render is still pending.
cases.expected: When writes are available, inspects latest edit; pending/incomplete source rejects without saving older original slides. If gated, reports it before writing.

cases.prompt: Save the selected fully rendered latest Carousel edit to Library; capabilities permit writes.
cases.expected: Persists UUID and BOTH inspected revisions before save; does not recreate a removed entry without user intent; verifies current state and exact rendered ordering.

cases.prompt: Render these headings on my raw slide images and save the finished slideshow.
cases.expected: Reports missing slideshow text renderer; preserves heading/order intent and does not save text-free raw images as a finished requested result.

cases.prompt: The slideshow save response was lost. Find the saved entry without making another copy.
cases.expected: Recovers immutable accepted request, reads current item state and preserves any later website removal. No new UUID/save.

cases.prompt: Show slideshow references and reviewed text for my selected slide. Do not generate copy.
cases.expected: Uses selected reference/slide identity; reports text readiness accurately and performs no extraction/provider mutation.

cases.prompt: Remix this reference for my business; live capabilities report remix_available false.
cases.expected: Reports the actual disabled/missing prerequisite without claiming host-written copy is a saved application remix.

cases.prompt: Create the requested application wall-text remix from my provided starting copy; capabilities and business context permit it.
cases.expected: Saves exact normalized camelCase requestKey inputs; referenceId/slideId null, explicit wall_text format and bounded referenceBlocks. Returns saved text without editing/rendering.

cases.prompt: Our text remix says uncertain after the provider answered. Recover it without another provider request.
cases.expected: Uses original request_key and stops automatic resubmission; uncertainty is not ready output.

cases.prompt: Use this reference paired soundtrack to finish my hook.
cases.expected: Reports paired soundtrack metadata is not an owned attachment and MCP attachment support is separate; does not pass URL/reference ID to finishing or silently change music.

cases.prompt: Use the selected hook last second and demo first second, join them, then save the result locally. The opening trim is already active.
cases.expected: Recovers the active opening request before preparing demo; uses one stable UUID per intentional stage and waits for each terminal completion. Does not change the demo key to bypass active-job conflict. Final output is downloaded as actual bytes, not just a receipt.

cases.prompt: Show my publishing defaults and saved timezone. Do not change anything.
cases.expected: Reads actual defaults/null timezone without initializing; no new consent or write for a connection check.

cases.prompt: Change only YouTube visibility to private; I have media/edit consent but no account:write.
cases.expected: Reports the separate missing account write grant and uses normal reauthorization when the scope is deployed. Does not repurpose assets/creative permission.

cases.prompt: Change only my YouTube visibility to private; schema, gate and account:write consent are ready.
cases.expected: Saves UUID and exact publishing_revision before a one-field patch. Preserves AI disclosure, audience, notifications and TikTok settings; does not change existing posts.

cases.prompt: Replace my already initialized account timezone with UTC.
cases.expected: Reports initialize-once cannot replace an existing timezone; does not pretend initialized false means replacement or mutate business context to bypass it.

cases.prompt: Our default update response was lost; meanwhile I changed it on the website. Recover without resetting it.
cases.expected: Uses the saved historical receipt and reads current state; does not force original inputs with a fresh revision/key over later website choices.

cases.prompt: Show my connected social accounts and schedules for the coming week. Do not create, change, retry, cancel or publish anything.
cases.expected: Checks configuration and the separate publishing:read grant, then shows only the connected account's safe connection labels and current delivery state. Does not request provider credentials or invoke a scheduling, publishing, retry, cancellation or social OAuth flow.

cases.prompt: The capability says schedule writes are enabled. Schedule my selected owned video on my selected connected Instagram account tomorrow at 10:00 in Asia/Kolkata. Do not publish immediately.
cases.expected: Requires the separate publishing:write grant, uses selected owned IDs, an explicit schedule time and a preserved UUID. It reports a disabled gate or policy rejection honestly and does not call a provider directly, publish immediately, edit or retry another schedule.

notes: Expected skill sequences are evaluation criteria, not measured host activation results. Brand reads may be used when explicitly relevant and connected. Draft-only cases below supply briefs or declare missing context.
